main.description: The answers behind one completed taste quiz, in the order given: what each question offered and which option the author chose. Written once and never edited; a retake is a new record. Kept so the response model that turns answers into a coordinate can be calibrated against what the same person later logs as pours. Every number is an integer.

responseModel.description: Which response model scored these answers when they were given. `softmax-grid-1`: a user picks each option with probability falling off with the squared distance from them to where the option places them (authored nudge × 2.5), noise inferred over three levels.

questionId.description: The question's id in the app's bank, or a generated id when `generated` is true.

kind.description: `triad`: tap the one you'd send back. `pair`: two options on one axis. `single`: choose the one you'd have.

generated.description: True when the question was written for this session rather than taken from the bank.

options.description: Every option offered, in the order shown, as authored at the time — the bank can change later, so the record carries what was actually asked.

chosen.description: Index into `options` of the one the author picked.

dxTenths.description: The option's authored nudge toward Crisp (+) or Rich (−), in tenths.

dyTenths.description: The option's authored nudge toward Sweet (+) or Savory (−), in tenths.
